## Changes

### New
- Merged comics: picking one source in the chapter list shows all of that source's chapters.
- Merged comics: a "Deduplicate chapters" switch in the chapter list's sources sheet, on by default. Turn it off to list every source's copy of a chapter number.
- Open in WebView on a merged comic asks which source's page to open.
- Open in WebView from the reader goes straight to the chapter's page, not the series'. Update your extensions to get it on every source.

### Fixes
- Open in WebView from the reader opens the source the chapter comes from, for merged comics.
- History names the source of the chapter you read last.
